population_kind: equal-weight synthetic nonlinear-truth primary-navigation challenge population; weights are design weights, not operational prevalence

cases.mechanism: frozen +8 m primary-only radial navigation bias for 30 s with the independent monitor channel unaffected
cases.justification: tests whether independent monitor information can alter a command corrupted by biased primary navigation

cases.mechanism: frozen 6 s primary-only packet dropout with the independent monitor channel unaffected
cases.justification: tests loss of primary information separately from biased primary information

configuration_comparison.monitor_input: processed for channel diagnostics but has no command authority

configuration_comparison.command_path: the same frozen deterministic vector LQR proposal through the frozen estimated-geometry gate and fallback

technical_failure_policy.estimator_or_monitor_fault_flags: report mechanism-specifically; never relabel as a physical event
technical_failure_policy.invalid_action_or_numerical_failure: separate technical invalidity; any occurrence closes confirmatory inference
technical_failure_policy.infrastructure_failure_or_missing_cell: no retry, replacement, imputation, or extension; any occurrence closes confirmatory inference
